summary: Frontend-only verification of Typography & Imagery Overhaul PRD (Home kinetic hero, editorial catalog rebuild, Quick Add, Filter/Sort sheets, product detail sticky ATC, cart drawer). All critical flows pass on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844, no console errors, no broken images, no horizontal overflow at 320px.
verified_features: Home hero-title renders 'A century of soil,' + 'in every grain' with SplitLines/mask reveal; <video data-testid=hero-video> and poster present (playback not verified — headless codec limitation, per agent note)
Editorial marquee visible; manifesto-section renders 3 chapters — all 3 manifesto-chapter images loaded (naturalWidth=806, unsplash urls, no 404)

Featured chips (All/Millets/Spices & Powders/Rices/Oils/Cookies/Snacks & Bars/Health Drinks) render and switch active state; grid re-renders reactively on chip change (chip=Millets returns 8 filtered products)
Home Quick Add (single-variant) increments header cart badge (0 -> 1) and shows toast 'added to cart'
Category gallery: 21 tiles render, hrefs point to /collections/<slug>
/collections/best-sellers: H1 'Shop all', category-rail with 22 tiles, sticky-filter-bar sticky-positioned, product-count reads '164 products'

FilterSheet opens with 35 options across Category (21) + Benefits (14), footer shows live 'Show N results' updating from 164 -> 2 on toggling Antioxidant benefit; URL updates to ?benefits=Antioxidant; applied-filter-chips render (chip-benefit-Antioxidant + Clear all)
chips-clear-all resets URL back to /collections/best-sellers with no query
SortSheet: choosing sort-option-price-low updates URL to ?sort=price-low and bar label to 'Sort: Price, low to high'
Editorial break-in cards: 20 rendered on /collections/best-sellers with no filters (~every 8 products across 164), 0 when a benefits filter is applied — behaviour matches spec
Multi-variant Quick Add (Oils): quick-add-sheet opens, quick-add-qty-increase works, quick-add-confirm-btn shows 'Add to cart · ₹854'; confirm closes sheet and increments cart
Empty state: ?benefits=NonExistentBenefit123 renders no-products block with empty-clear-filters-btn that resets filters
Product detail (/product/:id): image, size selector, quantity stepper, add-to-cart-btn all present and functional (cart badge increments)
Mobile 390px: sticky-mobile-atc rendered and visible after scrolling past main ATC on product detail

Cart drawer opens from header-cart-btn, shows item + Default Title + ₹55, checkout button data-testid=cart-checkout-btn triggers GET /api/shopify/checkout -> 200 (redirect URL generated). Purchase NOT completed.
Mobile catalog grid = 2 cols (173px 173px) at 390px viewport
No horizontal overflow at 320px: Home scrollWidth == clientWidth == 320; Catalog scrollWidth == clientWidth == 320

Typography audit: h1 computed font-family = '"Instrument Serif", serif'; body computed font-family = '"Hanken Grotesk", "Hanken Fallback", system-ui, sans-serif' — Instrument Serif + Hanken Grotesk resolved, no fallback to system-ui/Arial in primary position
No broken images (naturalWidth==0) on Home, best-sellers, product-detail, mobile viewports
No console errors captured across Home, catalog, product detail, cart drawer flows
critical_code_review_comments: BestSellers.jsx uses eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps twice — acceptable but consider stable deps via useCallback for applyFilters to avoid subtle stale-closure bugs when facet counts get more complex.
Home.jsx CHAPTERS + BestSellers.jsx have inlined arrays that duplicate PATH_TO_CATEGORY / MARQUEE / CHAPTERS style; consider colocating in /constants for reuse.

Home hero-title contains two spans across a fixed style block; screen-readers will read 'A century of soil,in every grain' with no space between the two lines — consider adding a visually hidden space or aria-label='A century of soil, in every grain' on the h1 for a11y.

success_rate.backend: n/a (not tested this iteration per request)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend GET /api/products supports per_page up to 200, Home + BestSellers fetch all 164 in one call. Hero <video> h264 mp4 cannot autoplay in Playwright headless — verify element/poster only. Multi-variant products live under /collections/oils (e.g., Virgin Coconut Cold Pressed Oil has 3 sizes). Cart drawer requires clicking header-cart-btn via JS after add-to-cart because Sonner toast (top-right) can overlay the cart icon for ~4s. Add-to-cart calls POST /api/cart with session_id; checkout via GET /api/shopify/checkout?session_id=… returns 200 with checkout_url.
